events.note: Found via zh.wikipedia 刘振立 references. Only the first ~1,500 characters of the dispatch were read (page fetched, but text was truncated by my extraction); later speakers (likely 苗华、张升民 and others) not captured. Recorded as a lead for the deliberation-day speaking order, not as a full roster.

gaps: Xinhua (news.cn) original urls for six of the eight reports (2023/2024/2026 tree-planting; 2024/2025/2026 receptions) could not be recovered: so.news.cn returns a 405 block page, Wayback CDX is blocked by egress policy, gov.cn search API returns no results, 81.cn has no reachable search endpoint and its article urls are undated numeric ids. The People's Daily/people.com.cn copies used instead carry the Xinhua dateline and 来源：新华网/新华社 line (except the 2024 reception, which is People's Daily's own 记者金正波 report; wording of Xinhua's 2024 text was not independently verified).

2024 Army Day reception: the Xinhua wire text was not read; only the People's Daily print report (《人民日报》2024-08-01 04版) was. The attendee sentence in Xinhua's version may differ marginally in wording (not in names).
CCTV pages for the 2024 and 2025 receptions (tv.cctv.com) contain only a one-line video summary, no transcript, so they only corroborate date and title.
No CMC vice-chair (张又侠/何卫东) is named at any reception 2023-2026; this appears to be the standard format rather than an omission, but no report says so explicitly.

Xi Jinping's separate April tree-planting with Politburo Standing Committee (党和国家领导人参加首都义务植树活动, e.g. 2023-04-04, 2024-04-03, 2025-04-03, 2026-03-30 on People) is outside this lane and was not read for military attendees.

Xinhua (news.cn) original pages for the four NPC delegation plenaries (2023-03-08, 2024-03-07, 2025-03-07, 2026-03-07) and for most 2024-2026 conferences were not located: no working search engine; People's Daily reprints on jhsjk.people.cn (习近平系列重要讲话数据库) and cpc.people.com.cn were used instead (same Xinhua dispatch text, 人民日报 01版).

January 2024 中央军委纪委扩大会议 (expected 张又侠/何卫东 speech + 军委委员 roster): not found. Tried zh.wikipedia full-text search ('军委纪委扩大会议' + 2024), People's Daily e-paper pages 01-04 for 2024-01-09..2024-01-20, and the 81.cn 军委 section index (only reaches back to ~late 2024).

January 2025 中央军委纪委扩大会议: only the CCTV-7 video page 简介 (何卫东 spoke) was readable; the Xinhua/PLA Daily text with any attendee roster was not located (People's Daily e-paper 2025-01-10/11 pages 01-04 negative).

NPC 解放军和武警部队代表团成立 reports (团长/副团长 designations, 2023-2026; the 2026 one would show who replaced 张又侠 as 团长): not found. People's Daily e-paper pages 01-04 for 2023-03-05/06, 2024-03-05/06, 2025-03-05/06, 2026-03-04/05/06 carry no such item; these run in 解放军报, whose search (search.81.cn) is unreachable through the proxy (CONNECT 502).

CMC-level conferences 2024-2025 not attended by Xi and not carried in the 81.cn 军委 section (e.g. any 2025 全军 work conferences chaired by 张又侠 or 何卫东, 军委扩大会议) may be missed; jhsjk.people.cn only indexes items that mention Xi. The 81.cn jw_208551 index pages 6+ return empty (94-byte) pages.

Plenum communiques (2024-07-18, 2025-10-23) name military figures only in disciplinary/appointment clauses; neither enumerates 军委领导 present (attendance given as counts only). No 2026 plenum has been held as of 2026-09-03 within the sources reached.
The 2023-03-06 delegation deliberation dispatch (news.cn c_1129417190) was only partially read (first ~1,500 chars); remaining speakers not captured.

2023 events outside the 2024-2026 bound of family 3 (e.g. the January 2023 老干部迎新春 gala, 2023-01 军委纪委扩大会议 for which zh.wikipedia cites tv.cctv.com/2023/01/13/VIDEnUbuaufTyO669dFsU4fg230113.shtml) were not pursued.
